subject: maths
question: Radhika requested the cashier of a bank to get her coins in lieu of her cheque worth ₹1,845. Cashier gave her a packet containing ₹5, ₹10 and ₹20 coins in the ratio of 3 : 5 : 7. What is the total worth of the smallest coin received by her?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Value ratio of coins = (₹5 × 3) : (₹10 × 5) : (₹20 × 7) = 15 : 50 : 140

Total value units = 15 + 50 + 140 = 205 units

205 units = ₹1845 ⇒ 1 unit = ₹9

Total worth of smallest coin (₹5) = 15 units = 15 × 9 = ₹135

**∴ The correct answer is ₹135.**
